biggest_catch: No direct deposit is required, but you must post $1,000 in total deposits AND 10 debit card transactions within the first 90 days — and when applying online you must use code FREECHECK (or mention the offer in person) or you get nothing.
catches: When applying online you must use promo code FREECHECK; in person you must mention the offer at account opening — otherwise the account is not eligible.
You must complete deposits totaling $1,000+ that post within the first 90 days AND make 10+ qualifying debit card transactions that post within 90 days; missing either disqualifies you.
The $200 is credited on or around day 91-97 after account opening — not sooner; the account must stay open with a balance of at least $0.01 until the reward is deposited, or it is forfeited.
Only first-time Community First checking holders qualify — members with an existing personal checking account or who previously closed one are not eligible; one bonus per member.
Membership is required (a $5 share account); confirm you meet their membership eligibility (Northeast Florida footprint) during application.
All offers may end at any time without notice — the page gives no fixed expiry date.

steps: Open a new Community First checking account as a first-time checking holder — apply online at communityfirstfl.org using promo code FREECHECK, or mention the offer if opening in person. Keep the $5 membership share funded.
Within the first 90 days of account opening, make deposits totaling $1,000 or more that post to the account (direct deposit is not required — any deposits count).
Within the same 90 days, make at least 10 qualifying debit card transactions that post to the account.
Keep the account open with a positive balance (at least $0.01) and in good standing until the reward lands — closing early or dropping to a negative available balance forfeits it.
The $200 bonus is credited to the checking account on or around day 91-97 after account opening.
timing: Application and setup take 30–60 min active; then $1,000 in deposits + 10 debit transactions over 90 days; $200 posts on day 91-97.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($200 flat); time: online application + deposit/debit activity est. 30-60 min active
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $200. Per official terms: Application and setup take 30–60 min active; then $1,000 in deposits + 10 debit transactions over 90 days; $200 posts on day 91-97. Earliest realistic: ~44 days (first payroll DD ~2 weeks + the payout window); the 90-day window is an outer limit.
maximize: Fastest honest path. The gating item is almost always your payroll cycle. Fastest honest path: open online today and switch a real payroll/government direct deposit immediately — employer payroll changes take 1–2 pay cycles, so start now; Zelle, bank-to-bank transfers, and microdeposits usually don't count as direct deposit. After the qualifying deposits post, the bank's payout window is fixed and nothing speeds it up.
